title: Words over a picture are judged against the picture shot under them, at desktop and phone width, by its worst part
steps: S1: overImageRatio for white words over a dark picture with one bright part (p15 0.01, p50 0.03, p85 0.62), over a calm dark one (p85 0.05), and dark words over a bright one.
S2: checkContrastReadable on a heading measured calm at desktop and bright at phone; on calm at both; on a grey picture (p85 0.26) as a heading and as body text.
S3: the same words unreadable at baseline (the template's own), then readable at baseline and unreadable after the build.
S4: group orange/white and brown/white text by the measured painted frame; include a passing neighbour and separate frames that reuse one image URL.
S5: a vision quote omits CITY from the measured hero; try two targets, an unmeasured viewport, clipping, two omissions, a replacement word, a number and a negation.
S6: a real Offers finding names an unquoted section heading and quotes its measured body; try unmatched, multiple and malformed quotes, possessive apostrophes and geometry.
expect: S1: the bright part fails (< 3:1), the calm picture passes; dark words fail on the bright picture.
S2: one finding, viewport phone, overImage true, needs 3; calm at both passes; the grey picture passes as a heading (3.39 ≥ 3) and fails as body text (< 4.5).
S3: the template's own unreadable words pass; words readable at baseline and unreadable later fail.

S4: both contrast directions remain available; orange and white share a dark range; incompatible uniform grounds are explicit; a passing neighbour constrains repair; different frames and missing frame identity are never inferred from the URL. Verdict thresholds stay unchanged.

S5: only the unique contrast quote with one non-critical omitted word at a successfully measured viewport defers to the contrast judge. All ambiguous, geometric, substituted, numeric or negated cases remain.

S6: the unique quoted body defers without false ambiguity from its section label. Duplicate measured targets, unmatched/multiple/malformed quotes and geometry remain findings; possessive apostrophes preserve correct quote boundaries.
evidence: Local rounds 27–31 (WordPress, JA Restaurant): looks-finished failed white headings over bright photos with no measured number; contrast-readable skipped every text over a picture.
fence: overImageRatio (p85 under light words, p15 under dark); MIN_CONTRAST_OVER_IMAGE 3 large / 4.5 text; OVER_IMAGE_WIDTHS; baseline unreadable over-image keys; groundRepair intersects both allowed ranges for every measured text in one frame; deferToMeasure requires one actual viewport measurement, keeps geometry faults and permits one non-critical omitted word only inside a quote

tests: contrast-readable judges words over a picture against the worst of what lies under them, at both widths
contrast-readable and no-text-overlap: white on white fails, text over a picture is not judged
contrast repair considers both ground directions and all texts in each measured background frame
contrast vision defers a unique measured quote with one omitted word only at its measured viewport
a unique measured quote is not made ambiguous by its unquoted section heading
quote identity keeps multiple, malformed, apostrophe and geometry boundaries
